entries.to_term: Fakalelei fai 'e Sisu he vaa 'o e 'Otua mo e tangata
entries.en_definition: The reconciliation between God and humans brought about by the sacrificial death of Jesus Christ
entries.to_definition: Ko e fakalelei 'i he vā 'o e 'Otua mo e tangata makatu'ung ahe feilaulau na'e fai 'e Kalaisi Sisu he'ene pēkia.

entries.en_definition: God’s act of removing the guilt and penalty of sin while at the same time declaring a sinner righteous through Christ’s atoning sacrifice.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono to'o 'e he 'Otua 'a e mo'ua mo e tautea 'o e angahala pea lau ai e taha angahala kuo angatonu tu'unga he fakalelei kuo fai 'e Kalaisi.

entries.en_definition: The process of being made holy, leading to a life of holiness and separation from sin.
entries.to_definition: Ko e ngaohi ke mā'oni'oni pea a'u ki he mo'ui mā'oni'oni 'o mahu'i mei he angahala.

entries.en_definition: The Christian doctrine that defines God as three consubstantial persons, the Father, the Son (Jesus Christ), and the Holy Spirit.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tokāteline fakakalisitiane ko e 'Otua mo hono fakahā'anga 'e 3 ko e Tamai, 'Alo, mo e Laumālie Mā'oni'oni.

entries.en_definition: The Christian belief that God became flesh, embodied in Jesus Christ, as both fully divine and fully human.
entries.to_definition: Ko e hoko 'o kakano 'a e 'Otua 'ia Sisu Kalaisi, 'o 'Otua mo tangata fakatou'osi.

entries.en_definition: The Christian belief that Jesus rose from the dead on the third day after his crucifixion, signifying victory over sin and death.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Tui Fakakalisitiane na'e toetu'u 'a Sisu mei he pēkia hili 'a e 'aho 'e 3 hono kalusefai, ko e fakamo'oni kuo Ne ikuna'i e angahala mo e mate.

entries.en_definition: The action of saving or being saved from sin, error, or evil through Jesus’ sacrifice.
entries.to_definition: Ko e ngāue fakahaofi mei he angahala, kovi mo e tēvolo makatu'unga he feilaulau na'e fai 'e Sisu.

entries.en_definition: Deliverance from sin and its consequences, believed by Christians to be brought about by faith in Christ.
entries.to_definition: Ko e fakahaofi mei he angahala mo hono nunu'a, koe'uhi ko e tui kia Kalaisi 'o fakatatau ki he tui 'a e kau kalisitiane.

entries.en_definition: The free and unmerited favor of God, as manifested in the salvation of sinners and the bestowal of blessings.
entries.to_definition: Ko e 'alo'ofa tu'unga'a pē 'a e 'Otua 'o fou mai 'i hono fakamolemole'i e kau angahala mo fai honau tāpuekina.

entries.en_definition: Complete trust or confidence in God and the doctrines of the Christian religion, especially the saving faith in Christ.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tui pikitai ki he 'Otua, 'o hangē ko e Tui Fakakalisitiane, ko e hao ia mei he 'auha he ko e tui kia Kalaisi.

entries.en_definition: The action of repenting; sincere regret or remorse for wrongdoing or sin.
entries.to_definition: Ko e fakatomala mo e ongo'i mamahi mo'oni he faikovi pē angahala.

entries.en_definition: The doctrine stating that sin entered the human world through Adam and Eve’s disobedience to God, and all human beings inherit a sinful nature.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tokāteline 'o e hū 'a e angahala ki he fa'ahinga 'o e tangta he talangata'a 'a 'Ivi mo 'Atama he kamata'anga.

entries.en_definition: The doctrine that all events have been willed by God, usually with reference to the eventual fate of the individual soul.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tokāteline ko e hoko mai 'a e me'a kotoa kuo 'osi tokateu pē 'e he 'Otua.

entries.en_definition: The part of theology concerned with death, judgment, and the final destiny of the soul and of humankind.
entries.to_definition: Ko e teolosia fekau'aki mo e mate, fakamaau mo e iku'anga 'o e laumālie 'o e fa'ahinga 'o e tangata.

entries.en_definition: Often synonymous with the end times, referring to the revelation of God’s will and the unfolding of divine judgment and salvation.
entries.to_definition: I he kuonga faka'osi, 'oku fakahā ai 'e he 'Otua hono finangalo 'ene fai fakamaau mo 'ene fai fakamo'ui.

entries.to_term: Ko e Toe ha'ele mai 'a Sisu Kalaisi
entries.en_definition: The anticipated return of Jesus to earth, prophesied in the New Testament, to fulfill the rest of Messianic prophecy.
entries.to_definition: Ko e 'amanaki ki he toe hā'ele mai 'a Sisu ki mamani ke fakakakato 'a e palofisaiki he Mīsaia, hangē ko ia na'e kikite'i he Fuakava Fo'ou.

entries.en_definition: A theological concept where believers are said to be taken up to heaven either prior to or during the tribulation.
entries.to_definition: Ko e teolosia hono 'ave e kakai tui ki Hevani kimu'a pē lolotonga e Fakamamahi Lahi.

entries.en_definition: A future period of time when suffering and persecution will reach a peak before the end of the world and the Second Coming of Christ.
entries.to_definition: Ko e taimi 'o e mamahi lahi kimu'a he 'osi 'a māmani, mo e toe hā'ele mai 'a Sisu.

entries.en_definition: The 1000-year reign of Christ on earth, a concept based on Revelation 20, with differing views on its timing relative to Christ’s return.
entries.to_definition: Ko e ta'u 'e 1000 'e pule ai 'a Kalaisi 'i māmani 'i ha'ane toe foki mai Fakahā vahe 20.

entries.en_definition: A figure who will emerge in the end times, opposing Christ and deceiving many.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tokotaha te ne fakafepaki'i 'a Kalaisi he kuonga faka'osi, pea mo kākā'i e tokolahi.

entries.en_definition: Symbolic figures in the book of Revelation, often associated with the Antichrist and systems of political and religious oppression.
entries.to_definition: Ko e taha 'oku hangē ha manufekai 'oku poupou ki he taha te ne fakafepaki kia Kalaisi he me'a fakapule'anga mo fakalotu.

entries.en_definition: A figure associated with the Antichrist who will perform signs and lead people away from the truth.
entries.to_definition: Ko e palōfita loi, 'e poupou kia Malakilaopē ko Fakafepaki kia Kalaisi pea mo mo'oni.

entries.en_definition: The site of a final battle between the forces of good and evil, predicted in the book of Revelation.
entries.to_definition: Ko e mala'etau 'e fepaki faka'osi ai e lelei mo e kovi 'oku talanoa ki ai e Tohi Fakahā.

entries.en_definition: The time when God will judge the living and the dead, rewarding the faithful and punishing the wicked.
entries.to_definition: Ko e taimi 'e fakamāu'i ai 'e he 'Otua 'a e mo'ui mo e mate, 'o fakapale'i 'a e kau failelei, kae tautea 'a e kau faikovi.

entries.en_definition: The Christian belief that the dead will be raised and reunited with their souls at the end of time.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Tui Fakakalisitiane 'e toetu'u e mate' 'i he 'aho fakamui.

entries.en_definition: The eternal dwelling place of God and the final abode for the righteous.
entries.to_definition: Ko e feitu'u 'oku 'afio ai 'a e 'Otua pea 'e nofo foki ai 'a e kau mā'oni'oni.

entries.to_term: Heli, Potu 'o e tangi & fengai'itaki 'o e nifo
entries.en_definition: The place of eternal punishment for the wicked
entries.to_definition: Ko e feitu'u 'e tautea ta'engata ai 'a e kau faikovi.

entries.en_definition: The heavenly city, described in Revelation, where God will dwell with His people in the new heaven and new earth.
entries.to_definition: Ko e kolo fakahevani fo'ou 'e 'afio ai 'a e 'Otua he'ene hā'ele mai ki mamani.

entries.to_term: Hevani fo'ou mo e mamani fo'ou
entries.en_definition: The renewed creation where God will reside with His people, free from sin and suffering, as described in Revelation 21.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Hevani Fo'ou mo e Mamani Fo'ou kuo fakatupu 'e he 'Otua ke 'afio ai mo hono kakai 'o 'ikai ha angahala pe ha faingata'a fakatatau ki he Tohi Fakahā vahe 21.

entries.en_definition: Refers to the final trumpet blast signaling the end of the world and the resurrection of the dead.
entries.to_definition: Ko e talupite 'e ifi he ngata'anga 'o mamani pea 'e toetu'u hake 'a e mate.

entries.en_definition: Described in Revelation as the final place of punishment for the devil, his followers, and the wicked.
entries.to_definition: Ko e anoafi 'e tautea ai e tēvolo, hono kau muimui mo e kau faikovi.

entries.en_definition: A heavenly record of those who are saved and granted eternal life with God.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Tohi 'oku hiki ai kinautolu kuo fakahaofi pea nau a'usia 'a e mo'ui ta'engata 'i he 'ao 'o e 'Otua.

entries.to_term: Taloni lahi hinehina 'o e Tu'I Fakamaau
entries.en_definition: The final judgment of all souls by Christ, as described in Revelation.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Fakamaau Tuku 'e fai 'e Kalaisi 'oku talanoa ki ai e Tohi Fakahā.

entries.en_definition: An early statement of Christian belief that summarizes core Christian doctrines, including the Trinity and the resurrection.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Tui Fakakalisitiane fekau'aki mo e tokāteline 'o e Tolu Taha'i 'Otua mo e toetu'u 'o e mate.

entries.en_definition: A Protestant principle that the Bible alone is the ultimate authority in matters of faith and practice.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Tui Fakapalotisani ko e Tohitapu' pē 'a e fakahinohino pau fekau'aki mo e tui mo e ngāue 'a e kalisitiane.

entries.en_definition: The Protestant doctrine that faith alone, apart from works, justifies the sinner before God.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Tui Fakapalotisani ko e tui', pē 'o 'ikai makatu'unga ha ngāue, 'oku fakatonuhia ai ha angahala 'e he 'Otua.

entries.en_definition: The belief that salvation comes by divine grace or unmerited favor only, not as something merited by the sinner.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tui ko e fakamo'ui' ko e kelesi pē 'a e 'Otua 'o 'ikai makatu'unga ha ngāue 'a ha taha angahala.

entries.en_definition: The set form of public worship, particularly in Christian church services.
entries.to_definition: Ko e fakahokohoko'o e ngaahi ouau lotu fai 'i ha Siasi Fakakalisitiane.

entries.en_definition: Also known as Communion or the Lord’s Supper; a sacrament commemorating the Last Supper of Jesus Christ with his disciples.
entries.to_definition: Ko e ouau 'o e Sākalameniti 'o e 'Ohomohe, ko e fakamanatu e 'ohomohe faka'osi 'a Sisu mo 'ene kau ako'.

entries.en_definition: A sacrament of initiation into the Christian faith, involving water as a symbol of purification.
entries.to_definition: Ko e faka'ilonga 'o e fanau'ifo'ou 'i he Tui Fakakalisitiane 'o faka'ilonga'i e fakama'a mei he angahala 'aki e Papitaiso Vai.

entries.en_definition: A short hymn of praises to God in various forms of Christian worship.
entries.to_definition: Ko e himi fakafeta'i nounou he kamata'anga 'o ha malanga pē feohi'anga lotu fakakalisitiane.

entries.en_definition: A blessing pronounced by the minister at the end of a service.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tāpuaki faka'osi 'i ha ouau feohi'anga fakalotu fakakalisitiane.

entries.en_definition: The table in a Christian church at which the bread and wine are consecrated in the Eucharist.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tēpile 'i ha Siasi Fakakalisitiane 'oku fakatāpui ai e mā mo e uaine 'o e Sākalameniti 'o e 'Ohomohe.

entries.to_term: Fakahokohoko e ng. Folofola ke lau he lotu
entries.en_definition: A book or listing that contains a collection of scripture readings appointed for Christian worship on a given day or occasion.
entries.to_definition: Ko e Tohi Lotu 'oku lau mei ai e folofola ki ha feohi'anga lotu fakakalisitiane.

entries.en_definition: The central act of worship in the Roman Catholic Church, which includes the celebration of the Eucharist.
entries.to_definition: Ko e misa he lotu 'a e Siasi Katolika, 'a ia 'oku fai ai e Sākalameniti 'o e 'Ohomohe.

entries.en_definition: A journey to a sacred place as an act of religious devotion, seeking closeness with God or to venerate a holy site.
entries.to_definition: Ko e fononga ki ha feitu'u toputapu ke fai ai ha lotu mo ha feohi mo e 'Otua.

entries.to_term: Hemiti, nofo tokotaha ke fai 'ene lotu
entries.en_definition: A person who lives in seclusion from society, usually for religious reasons, to pursue an ideal of total dedication to God.
entries.to_definition: Ko e taha 'oku nofo tokotaha 'i ha feitu'u ke lotu mo feohi mo e 'Otua.

entries.en_definition: A person who believes that nothing is known or can be known of the existence or nature of God.
entries.to_definition: Ko e taha 'oku ta'elotu, ko 'ene tui' 'oku 'ikai lava ha taha 'o 'ilo 'a e 'Otua.

entries.en_definition: The process of learning to follow Jesus Christ more closely, often involving mentorship and practicing spiritual disciplines.
entries.to_definition: Ko e ako ke lava 'o muimui ofi kia Sisu, mo tokanga makehe ke tupu 'ene mo'ui fakakalisitiane.

entries.en_definition: The anticipated savior of the Jews, prophesied in the Old Testament, whom Christians identify as Jesus Christ.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tokotaha 'oku 'amanaki ki ai e kau Siu' 'e ha'u ko e Mīsaia 'o hangē kuo 'osi kikite'i he Fuakava Motu'a, ka ko Sisu Kalaisi he lau 'a e kau kalisitiane.
